cohort: 149 neonates admitted to the Chatinkha Nursery neonatal unit at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital in Blantyre, Malawi, including 17 HIV-exposed and 132 HIV-non-exposed infants.
finding: There was a significantly lower incidence of clinical jaundice (bilirubin > 5 mg/dL) among HIV-exposed neonates compared to HIV-non-exposed neonates.
